about: The space station's shop in Secure the Base. Fly within `station.reach` of home base and press E to open it; your ship brakes to a stop while it is open (`station.brake`, higher stops faster) but the game keeps running, and it warns you when an enemy is within `station.warn_range`. You start with `start.credits` credits, `start.drills` drills, the weapons in `start.weapons`, `start.missiles` missiles and no shield. Each item's `price` is in credits. Drills: you can own up to `max` at once (carried plus set), and with `free_when_broke` the station gives you one free when you have none left and can't afford one, so you can never get stuck. Missiles come `pack` at a time, up to `max` carried. Health restores `restores` of your hull. The upgrades, mines and sentries show in the shop but arrive in the next sprint.
